items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: As a matter of fact, John Guarnieri was on that recording at the piano and Jimmy Shirley, whom I mentioned, and Jackie Williams.

ctx.x: Yeah, I've heard him. He's very -- he's got quite a reputation.
Right. As a matter of fact, John Guarnieri was on that recording at the piano and Jimmy Shirley, whom I mentioned, and Jackie Williams. But that particular
record session, when it came out, I was surprised to note that on the label of the album that we had made, it was called "Stef and Slam."
